# nasflix-intro

Intro animation for a personal Android TV app, built procedurally with Blender (Cycles)
and rendered on GitHub Actions.

* Characters: MakeHuman base mesh and targets through the MPFB2 add-on (CC0 assets),
  dressed in procedural foam-clay (tiny bead) clothes and hair
* Props: Poly Haven models (CC0), textiles restyled to foam clay
* Everything else is generated by the scripts in `scene/`

`Render intro v5` workflow: 20 parallel shards, frames and videos go to a hidden draft release.
